আজি ১৮ আগষ্ট তাৰিখে কে চি দাস কমাৰ্চ কলেজৰ ২০২৫ বৰ্ষৰ নৱাগত আদৰণী সভাখন অনুষ্ঠিত হয়। পুৱা ৯ বজাৰপৰা শ্ৰেষ্ঠ নৱাগত আৰু শ্ৰেষ্ঠ নৱাগতা প্ৰতিযোগিতাৰে দিনটোৰ কাৰ্যসূচী আৰম্ভ হয়
K. C. Das Commerce College successfully observed the International Day Against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking on 26th June 2026 with the objective of creating awareness among students about the harmful effects of drug abuse and the importance of building a drug-free society. The Program was organised by 1 Assam Bn. NCC and, NSS of the College.
MSME Day has been celebrated on 25/06/2026 in K.C. Das Commerce College. The event was organised by Research & Development Cell and Placement Cell of K.C.Das Commerce College in collaboration with FICCI FLO North East.
World Environment Day celebration on 5th June, 2026
On 19 May 2026, the Department of Bengali, in collaboration with the Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) of K.C. Das Commerce College, organised the "165th Rabindra-Jayanti Programme"
A national seminar on “Viksit Bharat at 2047: Thrives and Contribution Towards Sustainable and Inclusive Development” was held at K.C. Das Commerce College on 15 and 16 May 2026.
The Department of BBA, K.C. Das Commerce College successfully organized AD-O-MANIA 1.0 on 8th May,2026, showcasing the creativity, innovation, and advertising skills of the students.
On 9 May 2026, the Fifth “Ramesh Chandra Choudhury Memorial Debate Competition”, organised on a North-East regional basis, was held at K. C. Das Commerce College.
On 8 May 2026, a blood donation camp was organised at K. C. Das Commerce College under the joint initiative of the K. C. Das Commerce College Alumni Association and Marwari Sammelan, Guwahati Metro Branch
Senior Under Officer *Tushar Dey* of K C Das Commerce College has brought immense pride to his institution by being awarded the prestigious NER Best Cadet (SD) in the National Cadet Corps (NCC).
K. C. Das Commerce College Students Union organized a vibrant "Traditional Campus Bazar" on 21st April, 2026.
An Experience Sharing session on the “Mission Knowledge Programme” under UNESCO Association, Assam, followed by a Certificate Presentation Programme, was held on 11 April 2026 at K. C. Das Commerce College, Guwahati.
A Voluntary Blood Donation Camp was successfully organized on 6th April 2026 at K.C.Das Commerce College, Guwahati. The event was conducted under the initiative of the Red Ribbon Club of the college in association with Marwari Yuva Manch Guwahati Samridhi Branch.
The Department of Accountancy, K. C. Das Commerce College has organized an educational Field Trip for the student of B.com 6th Semester (Accountancy Major) on 28th March,2026.
The Department of Management, K. C. Das Commerce College has organised a "Report Presentation programme on Field Trip To Amchong Tea Estate" on 28th March, 2026.
Dr Kukil Borah participated in a 4 days (18th to 21st March '26) "MISSION KNOWLEDGE PROGRAMME " of UNESCO Association of Assam representing K C Das Commerce College in different part of Assam (Guwahati, Silapathar, Namsai,Tinsukia and Dibrugarh).
The Department of Management, K C Das Commerce College organised a field trip for the students of B.Com 6th semester (Marketing major) on 9th March 2026
On 6th March 2026, the Department of Economics of K. C. Das Commerce College, Guwahati organized a field survey on “Rubber Plantation in Assam: Problems and Prospects” at Sonapur, Kamrup (M).
On 6th March,2026 ,the Women's Cell of K.C.Das Commerce College, in association with the UNESCO Association, Guwahati organised a programme to celebrate the InternationaSl Women's Day,2026.
A popular talk on “The Future of E-Commerce with Agentic A.I.” has been organized by the IQAC and the Career Guidance and Placement Cell of K.C. Das Commerce College
The Department of M.Com, K.C.Das Commerce College has organised a Parent–Teacher Meeting for the students of M.Com 2nd and 4th semesters on 28th February 2026.
The 77th Republic Day was celebrated with great enthusiasm, fervour and patriotic spirit at K C Das Commerce College today.
On the occasion of College Week 2026 of K C Das Commerce College, the “Inter-College and University Idea Innovation Challenge 4.0” competition was held on 4th February 2026.
A Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) was exchanged today between the National Small Industries Corporation (NSIC), Government of India, and K.C. Das Commerce College during the MSME Marketing Conclave, held in the esteemed presence of Sushri Shobha Karandlaje, Hon’ble Minister of State, Ministry of MSME, Government of India.
The NCC Festival held on 23rd November at Guwahati Commerce College brought together cadets from different educational institutions under the prestigious 1 Assam Battalion. The event aimed to promote discipline, unity, leadership, and cultural pride through various evaluated activities and competitions.
An Orientation Programme on UNESCO Activities was organised by the IQAC, K.C. Das Commerce College in collaboration with UNESCO Association, Guwahati. The resource persons of the programme were Dr. Aswini Kumar Sarma, Executive Director, Resource Centre for UN-NER, and General Secretary, UNESCO Association, Guwahati; Dr. Nitul Gogoi, IPS, Ex-IGP (Assam Police), Life Member & Ambassador, UNESCO Association and Dr. Ashok Kumar Laskar, Life Member & Coordinator, UNESCO Association, Guwahati on 26th
The Industry Academia Meet,2025 was conducted by the Department of BBA, K.C. Das Commerce College in association with IQAC on 26th November,2025.
K.C.Das Commerce College organises workshops, seminars and special classes from time to time for the benefit of students. Another endeavour has been made by the Department of M.Com on 24/09/2025 by organising a special online class for the students of M.Com 1st semester.
Department of Accountancy, K. C. Das Commerce College organised an interactive discussion with a number of prominent CA Firms on 21.11.2025 in the College premises to discuss some internship related academic matters of students.
Institution's Innovation Council, K.C.Das Commerce College has celebrated World Entrepreneurs' Day on 21/08/2025 in Digital Conference Hall-2 of the college at 11 am. Resource person Shri Swapnanil Barua, IAS (Retd.), Former Commissioner of Industries and Commerce, Govt. of Assam has delivered a speech on the Significance of Entrepreneurship for our economy giving special emphasis on Cultural Entrepreneurship.
A deep sense of grief has engulfed the hearts of the people of Assam as well as the community of K C Das Commerce College over the untimely demise of the nationally acclaimed music artist Zubeen Garg.
Awareness Cell of Health and Hygiene, K.C. Das Commerce College organised a Guest Lecture and Counselling on ‘Depression and Self-Harm Behaviour among College students’ in collaboration with Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC), K.C. Das Commerce College on 20th December 2025.
As a part of celebrating "Seva Saptah" (initiated by the Government of Assam), a "SEEDLING PLANTATION DRIVE " has been organised by the Eco-Club , NSS and NCC unit of K.C Das Commerce College at Gandhi Mandapam Road , Sarania hills , Guwahati -03
NSS unit and Student Union of K. C. Das Commerce College organised a plantation drive of Nahar sapling in the college premises on the occasion of 53rd birth anniversary of prominent musician, singer and renowned artist Zubeen Garg on 18th November 2025.
The Career Guidance and Placement Cell of K C Das Commerce College, in collaboration with Assam Down Town University, organised a Soft Skills Training and Personality Development Programme on 15th September 2025.
The Department of Mathematics & Statistics organized a Guest Lecture on “Testing of Hypothesis” in association with the Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) of K.C. Das Commerce College. The primary objective of the programme was to underline the statistical concept of hypothesis testing by highlighting its components, crucial applicability, and real-life importance across various domains of study on 15 November 2025
79th Independence Day Celebrated at K.C. Das Commerce College
Awareness Cell of Health and Hygiene, K.C. Das Commerce College and Department of Endocrinology, G.M.C.H organized a “Diabetes Screening Camp” in association with internal Assurance Cell, K.C. Das Commerce College on 14th November 2025
Awareness Cell of Health and Hygiene, K.C. Das Commerce College organised a Health Awareness Program in Collaboration with Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) On 13th September 2025
The Career Guidance and Placement Cell of K.C. Das Commerce College organized a program on “New Career Opportunities in Emerging Field” in collaboration with Inspiring Education, Kolkata on 13th November 2025
A Voluntary Blood Donation camp was organized jointly by Red Ribbon Club of K.C. Das Commerce College and Marwari Sammelan, Guwahati Metro Shakha in collaboration with Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC), K.C. Das Commerce College on 12th August 2025
The Department of M.Com, K. C. Das Commerce College has organised a one-day Workshop on the theme "Systematic Literature Review and Statistical Analysis for Social Science Research" on 11/09/2025 in the Digital Conference Hall- II. The resource person for the workshop was Dr. Jewel Mayur Phukon, Assistant Professor (Sr.), Assam Don Bosco University. This workshop was attended by 55 students of M.Com as well as faculty members of the department.
On 8th September 2025, to commemorate the birth centenary of the legendary Bhupen Hazarika, fondly hailed as the Bard of the Brahmaputra and a recipient of the Bharat Ratna, the Literary Forum of K. C. Das Commerce College, in collaboration with the institution’s Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC)
Dr. Hrishikesh Baruah, Principal, K. C. Das Commerce College addressed the participants of North East Environment Youth Parliament at the Assam Legislative Assembly today alongside the inspirational Padma Shri Jadav Payeng.
K. C. Das Commerce College Celebrates 42nd Foundation Day with Enthusiasm and Reverence
Awareness Cell of Health and Hygiene, K.C. Das Commerce College organised “Free Eye Screening & Dental Check-up” in collaboration with Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC), K.C. Das Commerce College and Gauhati Lions Eye Hospital, Chatribari on 6th September 2025
Nijut Moina Asoni Programme at K.C. Das Commerce College
'Apprenticeship cum Job Fair' organised by Board of Practical Training (Eastern Region), Ministry of Education, Government of India in association with K.C. Das Commerce College has been held today (04/12/2025) in the college premises.
French Ambassador Visits K.C. Das Commerce College, Emphasises Climate Awareness & Indo-French Cooperation , 3rd November 2025
Celebrating Literacy Week, 1st September 2025 to 8th September, 2025.
Red Ribbon Club, K.C.Das Commerce College participated in observance of State-Level World AIDS Day organised by Assam AIDS Control Society held at Srimanta Sankaradeva Kalakshetra
Placement Drive conducted by 1 Assam Battalion NCC, Guwahati in association with K.C. Das Commerce College on 14th July 2026
